submitted.rationale: Mg antimonates such as MgSb2O6 have wide band gaps, so 2.1 eV light should barely be absorbed. All measured compositions gave EQE near zero (about 1e-5 to 1e-4 %). The Sb-richest composition (Sb 0.757, 3.3e-4 %) gave the highest value. It may be excess Sb oxide beyond the MgSb2O6 composition adding a little absorption. The differences are close to the noise floor.

rejected.reason: Close to MgSb2O6 stoichiometry; EQE 2e-5 %, negligible
